Dermalogica intensive moisture balance, on the Midrand routine desk: where moisturizer sits in a routine, what's in this one, and how to apply it.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link at https://dermatologist.joburg/.

• Ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin
• BioReplenish Complex of barrier lipids; prebiotic chlorella algae complex
• Hyaluronic acid with echinacea, centella asiatica and aloe vera
• After cleansing and toning, apply over face and neck in light, upward strokes, twice daily
• Sizes: 15, 50, 100 and 150 ml; recommended for normal to dry skin
